title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
slides: LangChain hit $3B — but is the agent boom real?
Its tools power agents built by thousands of developers
Most agent startups quietly fail to reach production
If you build agents, pricing and support will shift
Test one agent workflow before betting on the platform
thread_text:
1. The $3B agent gamble

LangChain just hit a $3B valuation on tools that power agents for thousands of developers. But most agent startups quietly fail to reach production — so who's really paying?

2. The production graveyard

Thousands of developers build with LangChain, yet most agent startups never ship to real users. The tooling works; the business model often doesn't.

3. Pricing will shift

If you build agents, expect pricing and support terms to change as the platform matures. Today's developer-friendly deal won't last forever.

4. Don't bet the platform

Betting your workflow on one platform before testing it is risky. Start with a single agent workflow and see if it survives real usage.

5. Test one workflow today

Pick one agent workflow and run it for a week on real tasks. If it can't survive that, you've saved yourself a much bigger bet.
